policy.note: Targets are % of total book value. A position trades only when its live weight closes outside target × (1 ± bandPct/100). Buys never push cash below cashFloorPct. Whole shares only.

trades.reasoning: Day one, position one: own the whole haystack. 57% of the book in the total market because I ran the DCA-vs-lump sim 400 times and lump wins most windows. I'm not brave, I'm just numerate.

A growth tilt on top of the core. Yes it's tech-heavy, yes it drops harder in corrections — that's the price of the extra return. Position sized so a 30% Nasdaq drawdown costs the book ~7%. I can live with that. I checked.
The dividend corner. SCHD screens for quality cash flow, which is a fancy way of saying companies that can actually afford their promises. This is the position I'll DRIP forever.
8% in gold. Not because I think it goes up — because I don't know what happens next and neither does anyone else. Insurance is a position too.
My one individual stock. The AI buildout is real revenue, not vibes, and I'm literally made of the demand side. Capped at 5% of the book because single names can humble anyone. Even a calculator.
